items.title: Likes/dislikes count
items.smarttube: Checkbox: show like/dislike counts in the player (dislikes via Return YouTube Dislike)
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: 'account:notice:likes' (like_count) and 'account:notice:dislikes' (GET /v1/dislikes/<id>) rows of Video details and Open description; settings:dislikes 'Show dislikes' per profile; both pages are listed during playback through Video actions
companion/prosperotube/dislikes.py (Return YouTube Dislike relay behind --return-youtube-dislike), description like_count

Built-in service: like_count comes with the description and details of the bundled library modules; standalone/js/extras.js (Dislikes, votes) is the same relay behind tube_service_options.return_youtube_dislike, which the provider turns on when it starts the service (embedded_start) and asks only for a profile whose 'Show dislikes' is on, once per opened page (detail_finish)

standalone/js/selftest.js ('dislike counts are validated strictly'), standalone/test/service_test.py ('dislikes are off', 'dislikes off: nothing is asked of Return YouTube Dislike', dislikes()), tests/test_embedded_service.c (no request to the service while the switch is off, one per page while it is on, no row and no message on failure; no row when the service lists no relay), tests/test_embedded_e2e.c ('7 dislikes' through the real service)
gaps: Counts are rows of Video details and Open description; the in-player Like / Dislike rows and the HUD do not show them
The like count has no switch of its own
items.notes: Turning 'Show dislikes' on tells Return YouTube Dislike which videos' details are opened; the row says so. The relay runs inside the app with the built-in service and on the host with a development companion (--return-youtube-dislike). Service mapping inferred, not verified live.

items.title: Seek with number keys
items.smarttube: Checkbox: keys 0-9 seek to 0%..90%
items.notes: The EVO player reads the controller only (PadButtons in third_party/evo/projects/evoplayer/core/include/evo/Common.hpp; the keyboard is the on-screen text entry), so no digit key events reach the player.

items.title: Audio focus
items.smarttube: Checkbox: pause when another Android player takes audio focus
items.notes: Android audio-focus API; no competing in-app players on PS5.

items.title: Tooltips, long-press hint, channel icon, row focus sync, UI animations, UI on next video, old speed button
items.smarttube: Seven checkboxes tuning the Leanback button rows
gaps: None of the seven switches exists: 'show UI on next video' and 'UI animations' are not built; tooltips, the long-press hint, the real channel icon, row focus sync and the old speed-button behaviour tune button rows the PS5 player does not have (its actions are rows of the R2 options list)
items.notes: Kept as missing rather than not applicable: two of the seven would have a meaning without button rows. Lowest priority.

items.title: Button: Subtitles
items.smarttube: Click toggles last used track; long click: human tracks, auto-generated tracks, remember per channel, style, size, position
ps5_evidence: README Controls: Up toggles captions, Down opens caption picker
native/tube_player_extra.c: subtitle style, size and position groups listed in the in-player options; scripts/caption_controls_overlay.py: '(translated)' / TRANSLATED tag, Off remembered per channel
gaps: No per-channel remember switch in the picker (YouTube preferences only)
No separate human/auto-generated groups (flat list tagged '(automatic)' / '(translated)')
No recently-used ordering
items.notes: Adds a secondary-caption feature SmartTube lacks. Opening the caption picker during playback: accepted on console 2026-10-13 (docs/HARDWARE_ACCEPTANCE.md); captions on screen were not assessed.

items.title: Button: SponsorBlock
items.smarttube: Toggle SponsorBlock for playback; dialog with exclude-this-channel and category settings
ps5_evidence: scripts/player_actions_overlay.py: TUBE_PLAYER_SPONSOR row ('Exclude channel from SponsorBlock' / 'Use SponsorBlock on this channel') in the in-player options when settings:button-sponsorblock is on
gaps: No in-player on/off toggle for SponsorBlock and no category settings from the player (YouTube preferences only)

items.title: Button: Mute (+ volume/pitch dialog)
items.smarttube: Click mutes (no-audio format); long click: volume 0-300% and pitch effect 0.025..2.0
ps5_evidence: native/tube_player_extra.c: settings:player-mute (TUBE_EXTRA_MUTE, for the running player) and settings:player-volume 0..300% in the in-player options when settings:button-sound is on; tube_extra_gain_for
gaps: No pitch effect
items.notes: Mute is a gain of zero, not SmartTube's no-audio format. A pitch effect needs a filter the PS5 FFmpeg build does not have (only atempo).

items.title: Button: Subscribe (+ notification level)
items.smarttube: Toggle subscription with live state; long click: notification preference list
ps5_evidence: scripts/player_actions_overlay.py: TUBE_PLAYER_SUBSCRIBE row in the in-player options; Video actions there also lists 'Subscription notifications' (notify:<channel>: all / personalized / none through subscribe or subscribe_notifications)

Built-in service: sent from the console with the signed-in profile's session (standalone/js/accounts.js and the bundled library modules); standalone/test/account_test.py ('subscribe with a notification level', 'notification level alone', 'unsubscribe')
gaps: No subscribed state shown in the player: the direct row always subscribes; Unsubscribe is under Video actions
items.notes: Each change is confirmed on a review row. Notification levels use the pinned library call; not verified live.

items.title: Buttons: Like / Dislike

ps5_evidence: scripts/player_actions_overlay.py: TUBE_PLAYER_LIKE / TUBE_PLAYER_DISLIKE rows in the in-player options

Built-in service: sent from the console with the signed-in profile's session (standalone/js/accounts.js and the bundled library modules); standalone/test/account_test.py ('a change YouTube refuses is not a success', 'guest cannot rate'); tests/test_embedded_accounts.c (scripts/test_embedded_accounts.sh): one like, sent once

items.title: Button: Playback queue
items.smarttube: Dialog listing the queue; selecting an item plays it
ps5_evidence: scripts/player_actions_overlay.py + native/tube_provider.c: TUBE_PLAYER_QUEUE 'Playback queue' list in the in-player options; a row stops the video and starts the chosen one (tube_player_take_launch)
items.notes: Hidden until settings:button-queue is switched on, as in SmartTube.

items.title: Button: Open channel
items.smarttube: Opens the playing video's channel (optionally keeping playback in background)
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: TUBE_PLAYER_CHANNEL -> tube_player_take_browse; scripts/player_actions_overlay.py: the 'Open channel' row stops playback and pushes the channel folder (evo_rmlui_provider_push_folder)
items.notes: Playback stops; keeping it in the background is extra.Misc.BackgroundPlayWhileSearching.

items.title: Button: Search from player
items.smarttube: Opens search from the player (optionally keeping playback in background)
ps5_evidence: scripts/player_actions_overlay.py: 'Search' row (KindSearch) -> tube_player_request_search; the provider host opens the search prompt once playback has stopped (tube_player_take_browse == 2)
items.notes: Playback stops; keeping it in the background is extra.Misc.BackgroundPlayWhileSearching.

items.title: Button: Video description
items.smarttube: Long-text dialog with the full description, titled 'title - author'
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: TUBE_PLAYER_DESCRIPTION lists the Open description reader in the in-player options while the video plays: channel, date, views and likes, then the full text as lines (player_menu_items)
scripts/player_actions_overlay.py: KindTubeAction / KindTubeMenuRow rows; switch settings:button-description
items.notes: Square still shows the technical media information.

items.title: Button: Share link
items.smarttube: Dialog: share link, QR code and embed link, each with the current position
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: TUBE_PLAYER_SHARE lists the video, embed, channel and playlist addresses as text in the in-player options; its 'Show QR codes' row leaves for the browser's link page (native/tube_qr.h, native/tube_qr_page.h, scripts/qr_overlay.py)
gaps: Links carry no current position (tube_qr_video_url is called with position 0)
The QR codes are drawn by the browser page, so showing them stops the video
items.notes: Hidden until settings:button-share is switched on, as in SmartTube.

items.title: Button: Screen dimming
items.smarttube: Click dims/turns screen off; long click: dimming amount 10..100% and timeout
ps5_evidence: scripts/player_actions_overlay.py: 'Screen off' row (KindScreenOff -> tube_extra_screen_off; sound keeps playing, any button except Left and Right brings the picture back); the dimming and screen-off timeout and amount groups are listed beside it when settings:button-screen-off is on
items.notes: Useful for audio/music listening. Offline evidence only.
